scope: Admission before any new model requests. Source intakes and already started CPU controls are reported separately from a model benchmark.

gates.name: exact_context
gates.criterion: Pinned interpreter, imports, complete unchanged target, approved axiom closure, and protected-cell checks match. Printed goal text alone cannot bind source.

gates.name: structural_headroom
gates.criterion: At least two genuine source failure states show meaningful improvement in same-target completeness or complete cost over both compiler-guided local repair and a strong equal-action baseline. A synthetic mutation or source proof positive control does not satisfy this gate.

gates.name: minimum_release_necessity
gates.criterion: Each claimed minimum must have an accepted full proof after release and a Lean refutation of every strictly smaller fixed scope. Finite candidate search failure and timeout grant no impossibility certificate.

gates.name: prior_art_distinction
gates.criterion: Preserving or releasing proved nodes, typed local edits, and exact finite replay are existing capabilities. The proposed distinction needs a measured increment over an equal-action implementation of those capabilities.

gates.name: independent_source_split
gates.criterion: Any model pilot must freeze 12–24 independent tasks or source projects, protect proof answers and equivalent theorem imports, and verify all complete outputs in the matching environment.

conditional_no_go: If a necessary gate lacks qualifying evidence, report measured CPU and source results, leave model denominator zero, and retain failed attempts as scoped development evidence.
